test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following territories to the south and north were made part of the Chola kingdom by the successors of the ruler Vijayalaya?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Pandyan and __****__Pallava.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vijayalaya's successors **expanded the kingdom's borders by conquest, increasing its size and power.
 
• The **Pallava and Pandyan** regions to the south and north were integrated into this kingdom.
 
• The Godavari-Krishna River basin in the north, the **Konkan coast in Bhatkal,** the entire Malabar Coast (the Chea region), in addition to Lakshadweep, and the Maldives were all portions of the Chola Empire at its height.
 
• His son** Aditya Chola I **succeeded him, and he built the Imperial Chola Empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vijayalaya was a member of the **Uraiyur Chola family**. Muttaraiyar, the head of the Kaveri Delta, was vanquished by him.
 
• He built a temple for the goddess **Nishumbhasudini** and the town of** Thanjavur**.
 
• The Chola empire was constructed by his** successors**.
 
• He built a lot of Shiva temples.
 
• The first significant Chola king, Parantaka I, succeeded him in **907 A.D**. As an ambitious leader, Parantaka I started his reign off with conquest-focused conflicts.
 
• From** Rajasimha II of the Pandyas**, he took control of Madurai.
 
• He took on the name **Maduraikonda (captor of Madurai)**.
 
• The Maldives were also annexed by him.
 
• Their rivalry with the Chalukyas grew as a result of the conquest and annexation of various portions of contemporary Mysore in other locations.
 
• The** majestic Brihadeshwara or Rajaraja Temple **in Thanjavur, which was erected by Rajaraja and finished in 1010, is a Shiva temple. It is regarded as a spectacular example of **South Indian style architecture**.
